title: Create PR for iteration 01.1
description:
## Objective
One PR for the whole iteration, targeting the base branch.

## Implementation
1. Base branch is in `.devmeta/increments/increment-01-zmf/base-branch`. Read it, do not assume main.
2. Push the feature branch and open the PR with `gh pr create`.
3. Body: what shipped, the 19-slide outline, and how to verify.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build` and `cd slides && npm run slides` before opening the PR.
acceptance_criteria: PR open against the base branch, build green
